description: Implementation of ShoppingCartDao interface providing database access methods for ShoppingCart entities, including retrieval by ID, code, customer, and store, as well as removal.

classes.name: ShoppingCartDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for ShoppingCart, providing methods to access and manipulate shopping cart data in the database.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its ID.

methods.name: getShoppingCartById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its ID, including merchant store details.

methods.name: getShoppingCartByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its code.

methods.name: getById (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its ID and associated MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its code and associated MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart associated with a specific Customer.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Removes a ShoppingCart from the database.
